turns.user_utterance: The ATM at Metro bank on High St. Kensington didn't return my card. What should I do now that the bank is closed?
turns.assistant_response: Sorry that happened. Since the ATM kept your card, please call your card support/ATM support line for an out-of-hours option, and if you can’t reach them immediately, lock your card in the app to prevent any further use. When you’re able, also note the ATM location (Metro Bank, High St, Kensington) and the time of the transaction so support can help with retrieval. Can you tell me: is it definitely an ATM of Metro Bank and do you still have the receipt showing the time?
